title: AIR CONDITIONING-GENERAL SPECS & PROCEDURES
summary: Air conditioning (RPO C60) plant procedures: evacuating and charging the A/C system (vacuum level and hold-time limits), refrigerant leak test limits, and the cooling functional test with required outlet temperature drop. No parts installed.

materials.where: Evacuate & charge step 3: charge the system with the specified amount

notes: Evacuate & charge: 1) Attach vacuum-charging lines to the Schrader fittings. 2) Evacuate to at least 25 mm Hg absolute; after a 15-second hold (time between vacuum disconnect and charge connect) pressure must not exceed 28 mm Hg absolute. Longer hold times allow the limits in Table #1. 3) Charge with the specified amount of refrigerant (150a, see UPC 0). 4) Disconnect the lines and cap the fittings.

Leak test detector sensitivity: compressor seal and sight glass - no leak at 1 lb in 5 years; suction throttling valve diaphragm - 1 lb in 10 years; all other lines, connections and components - 1 lb in 40 years.

Cooling functional test: doors or windows open; temperature indicators at condenser inlet and RH upper cooling outlet; close LH side, center and lower RH outlets; set temperature pointer .3 in. to rear of "COLD" (outside air, water valve closed), outlets pointer at "A/C" (full forward), blower on HIGH; run engine at 2000 RPM; after one minute check the RH upper outlet temperature drop.
